known_limitations: Implemented as a CLI puzzle rather than a graphical board.
Puzzle generation is a fixed 3x3 starting board; there is no random shuffling or multi-level campaign.
Update checks are not implemented because the delivered game is standalone and offline-only.
The hint system is not implemented beyond the core move/undo/restart flow.
Stats export is local JSON only and does not include complex legacy session summarization.
Corrupt save recovery resets to a fresh session instead of reconstructing partial progress.
